主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced on June 1, 2018, that it has determined the quarterly dividend on its floating rate Cumulative Class A Preference Shares, Series 25 (TSX: BAM.PR.S). The dividend is paid at an annual rate of 2.30% over the annual yield on three-month Government of Canada treasury bills, calculated for each quarter. The company declared a quarterly dividend rate of 0.9074% (3.6% annualized) for the period July 1, 2018 to September 30, 2018, with a dividend of $0.22685 per share payable on September 28, 2018. The company is a leading global alternative asset manager with approximately US$285 billion in assets under management.
